content:
maya: Heads up — infra noticed a 2.7x cost jump last week tied to trace retention for a few high-traffic tenants. Can we revisit retention + sampling heuristics?

raj: saw that in the billing dashboard. A few long-running request types keep full traces around for 30d. Cost per tenant spiked.

katie: are we sure it's retention and not just increased ingest? I pulled a sample: most extra volume is large spans + baggage.

maya: good q. we correlated object sizes with retention buckets. Tenants with lots of debug logs in spans pushed them into hot retention and kept them.

raj: proposed approach: tiered retention + adaptive sampling. Keep full traces for errors and high-SLO violations, TTL short for low-value successful traces. sample rate ramps by tenant budget and recent error rate.

tim: big thing: attribution. If we sample before enrichment we lose billing keys and tenant context. If after, cost stays high. Need a handshake.

ingest-bot: NOTE: late enrichment (billing_key join) currently runs in enrichment stage; sampled traces often miss the join.

katie: thought: write a compact header at request time with minimal billing id + attrs (canonical service, trace_bucket) so we can safely sample early and still attribute. Header size ~40 bytes.

maya: example config sketch for adaptive sampler:

```
{ "default_sample_rate": 0.01,
  "error_override": 1.0,
  "tenant_overrides": {
    "low_budget": {"min_rate": 0.0001, "max_rate": 0.02},
    "high_budget": {"min_rate": 0.1, "max_rate": 1.0}
  },
  "ramp_on_error_window_secs": 300
}
```

raj: love it. implementation notes:
- sampling decision at edge using compact header for attribution
- emit a sampled=true marker so downstream collectors keep the full KV cache
- if enrichment later fails to find billing key, mark as partial-attribution and emit a billing_lookup_missing metric

tim: fallback for unknown tenants: keep a short-grace retention (48h) and do async backfill of billing keys when enrichment eventually succeeds. don't allow indefinite retention without billing.

katie: operational metrics we need to add before rolling: sampled_traces_rate, sampling_recovery_pct, billing_lookup_missing, retention_ttl_bytes_by_tenant. Also a per-tenant cost_estimate_preview.

maya: experiments: roll to 5% of traffic for 2 weeks. two cohorts: header-enabled vs header-disabled. check attribution fidelity and cost delta.

raj: one more tradeoff: compact header leaks a tiny amount of metadata to edge; need privacy review for PII. header will be canonical tenant id only (no user PII).

tim: agree. add KMS-signed header option if security team insists.

maya: action items:
- raj: prototype edge sampler + header (PR expected EOW)
- katie: add metrics + dashboards for cohorts (by monday)
- tim: draft privacy/KMS note and fallback policy

katie: i'll also draft a short runbook for when billing_lookup_missing spikes so SRE knows whether to increase retention temporarily.

maya: thanks — let's aim for the canary next Tue. will post experiment kickoff in #release-war-room and link here. :thumbsup:
